name: survey
description: Put a question to the class and show the answers on the projector. Type /survey followed by the question and it goes up immediately — Claude reads the sentence, works out the question type and the right answer, and the app runs it: multiple choice, word clouds, confidence scales, numeric estimates, and rankings, all updating live as students answer. /survey with a filename loads a poll written before class, and the projector's menu jumps to any question at any time. Runs at a fixed public address, so students join with no tunnel and no waiting. Anonymous by design, so concept checks get honest answers.
